Title: Making Candles - Part 2
Content: This process proved to be too time-consuming, however, so other options were
developed to be more efficient. Beeswax became the most popular substance to
use in candle making. `ultext(Paraffin wax is currently the most-used product in creating)`
`ultext(Although there are several ways to make candles by using molds; most traditional)`
`ultext(candles are made by one of two other methods.)` `text(One)` method is to dip a wick
over and over in melted wax repeatedly until the desired thickness is achieved. The other
method is to use a sheet of softened wax and roll it tightly around a wick.
